BEUI-animated-number.name: Animated Number
BEUI-animated-number.summary: Counts from 0 to the target on an ease-out curve, fast at first and slowing down, with thousands separators. It starts once it enters the viewport and shows the final value right away in reduced-motion mode.

BEUI-animated-toast-stack.name: Animated Toast Stack
BEUI-animated-toast-stack.summary: New toasts spring up from below with a blur while older ones make room. When a toast switches from loading to success, the icon and text roll over in place; drag one sideways to fling it away, or let it fade out on its own.
BEUI-animated-toast-stack.hint: Tap a button to push a toast · Drag sideways to dismiss

BEUI-bouncy-accordion.name: Bouncy Accordion
BEUI-bouncy-accordion.summary: The row you open springs away from the list, leaving gaps above and below and rounding its corners, while the content area expands on a bouncy spring. Close it and everything snaps back into one block.
BEUI-bouncy-accordion.hint: Tap any row · Tap again to close

BEUI-button-base.name: Button
BEUI-button-base.summary: The whole button shrinks along a spring curve when pressed and bounces back on release, with a slight scale-up on hover. Four styles and three sizes share the same feel.
BEUI-button-base.hint: Press and hold, then let go

BEUI-button-magnetic.name: Magnetic Button
BEUI-button-magnetic.summary: When the pointer comes close, the button is pulled toward it with a spring-driven offset, then snaps back when the pointer leaves. Turns itself off on touch screens and in reduced-motion mode.
BEUI-button-magnetic.hint: Move the pointer around the button

BEUI-button-stateful.name: Stateful Button
BEUI-button-stateful.summary: After a tap, the label rolls up out of view letter by letter with a blur while the new state's text rolls in; the icon springs open from zero width and the button width eases along. It runs idle → loading → done, then returns to idle.
BEUI-button-stateful.hint: Tap once and watch all three states

BEUI-digit-swap.name: Digit Swap
BEUI-digit-swap.summary: Digits stay in fixed slots and only the ones that change roll over: the old character slides out and fades up (or down) while the new one slides in from the other side, a few milliseconds apart per digit.
BEUI-digit-swap.hint: Tap to swap in a new number

BEUI-dock.name: Dock
BEUI-dock.summary: A frosted-glass bar holds a row of icons, and the selection is a translucent plate that springs from the old icon to the new one when you tap. You can drop dividers in between.

BEUI-expandable-control.name: Expandable Control
BEUI-expandable-control.summary: A round icon button grows a text label sideways when tapped, with the pill stretching as one continuous surface and the text fading in through a light blur. A tag chip next to it grows an action slot when tapped.
BEUI-expandable-control.hint: Tap the icon · Tap again to collapse

BEUI-hold-action-button.name: Hold Action Button
BEUI-hold-action-button.summary: Hold it down and a wavy-edged liquid fills the whole button at a steady pace, from the bottom or from the left, and triggers once full. Let go midway and the liquid drains back quickly.
BEUI-hold-action-button.hint: Keep holding until the liquid fills up

BEUI-morphing-modal.name: Morphing Modal
BEUI-morphing-modal.summary: The whole backdrop blurs and dims while the panel springs up from below (or the center). Switching views inside the modal doesn't close it: the height morphs continuously to fit the new content, with the old content blurring upward out and the new sliding in from below.
BEUI-morphing-modal.hint: Tap to open · Switch views inside the panel

BEUI-range-slider.name: Range Slider
BEUI-range-slider.summary: Drag or tap the track and the thin thumb and fill spring after the target; while held, the thumb stretches vertically with a bounce and relaxes on release. Tick marks can follow the step size, and arrow keys work.
BEUI-range-slider.hint: Drag the thumb · or tap anywhere on the track

BEUI-slide-action-button.name: Slide Action Button
BEUI-slide-action-button.summary: Drag the handle all the way to the right and the fill follows your progress, while the arrow icon morphs into a check on the way. Release past the threshold and it springs home to complete; fall short and it bounces back to the start.
BEUI-slide-action-button.hint: Drag the handle all the way right

BEUI-switch.name: Switch
BEUI-switch.summary: The thumb glides from one end to the other on a heavy, well-damped spring, steady with no wobble. While pressed it flattens and stretches toward its target, and the track color fades in step.
BEUI-switch.hint: Tap to toggle · Hold to see the thumb squash

BEUI-tabs.name: Tabs
BEUI-tabs.summary: The selection plate glides smoothly between tabs with no overshoot, and the label color is inverted pixel by pixel as the plate passes over it, while the content area floats up slightly as it switches. Pill, underline and segment styles.

BEUI-text-reveal.name: Text Reveal
BEUI-text-reveal.summary: Each word (or letter) springs up from below with a blur and fades in, entering one after another. Multi-line text is grouped by line, and long sentences wrap between words.
BEUI-text-reveal.hint: Hit replay to watch it again

BEUI-text-scramble.name: Text Scramble
BEUI-text-scramble.summary: When the text changes, the whole line first turns into random characters, then settles into the new sentence one slot at a time from left to right. The noise reshuffles every 40ms, the total duration is adjustable, and reduced-motion mode switches instantly.
BEUI-text-scramble.hint: Tap to swap in a new line

BEUI-text-shimmer.name: Text Shimmer
BEUI-text-shimmer.summary: A bright band sweeps across gray text at a steady pace and loops, done purely with a CSS gradient shift. Often used for waiting copy like "Generating…", and holds still in reduced-motion mode.

changes: Remote sample images replaced with /placeholder/*.svg (viewable offline)

MAGIC-border-beam.name: Border Beam
MAGIC-border-beam.summary: A band of gradient light runs around the card border at a steady pace while the rest of the border stays as it was. It lights up only the outline and never touches the content.
MAGIC-border-beam.hint: Watch the light circle the card edge

MAGIC-confetti.name: Confetti
MAGIC-confetti.summary: On tap, a burst of confetti shoots out from the button, scatters under gravity and fades away; a full-screen canvas also throws one round on mount.
MAGIC-confetti.hint: Tap the button to throw confetti

MAGIC-dock.name: Dock
MAGIC-dock.summary: When the pointer nears, icons spring larger by distance, their neighbors swell along with them, and everything shrinks back on leave, recreating the feel of the macOS Dock.
MAGIC-dock.hint: Sweep the pointer across the icon bar

MAGIC-hyper-text.name: Hyper Text
MAGIC-hyper-text.summary: Letters first scramble through random capital characters, then settle into the real text one slot at a time from left to right; hover to decode it again.

MAGIC-interactive-hover-button.name: Interactive Hover Button
MAGIC-interactive-hover-button.summary: On hover, the small dot on the left swells to fill the whole button as a solid base, the original text slides away, and the same text with an arrow slides in from the right.
MAGIC-interactive-hover-button.hint: Put the pointer on the button

MAGIC-magic-card.name: Magic Card
MAGIC-magic-card.summary: As the pointer moves over the card, a two-tone gradient highlight lights up along the border and a soft glow rises across the card face; both fade out on leave.
MAGIC-magic-card.hint: Move the pointer over the card

MAGIC-marquee.name: Marquee
MAGIC-marquee.summary: Four columns of review cards scroll up and down at a steady pace on a tilted perspective plane, with neighboring columns running in opposite directions; the whole thing stops on hover.
changes: Remote sample images replaced with /placeholder/*.svg (viewable offline)

MAGIC-meteors.name: Meteors
MAGIC-meteors.summary: Tiny points of light streak diagonally across from above with fading trails and then dissolve; random delays and durations make the whole thing feel like a real meteor shower.

MAGIC-number-ticker.name: Number Ticker
MAGIC-number-ticker.summary: The number rolls from 0 to the target, accelerating like a spring and slowing to a steady stop near the end. Suits key metrics on a data dashboard.
MAGIC-number-ticker.hint: Hit replay to roll it again

MAGIC-orbiting-circles.name: Orbiting Circles
MAGIC-orbiting-circles.summary: Two rings of icons orbit along concentric tracks at steady paces, the inner and outer rings going opposite ways at different speeds, while each icon itself stays upright.
MAGIC-orbiting-circles.hint: Watch the two rings turn in opposite directions

MAGIC-pulsating-button.name: Pulsating Button
MAGIC-pulsating-button.summary: A same-colored halo under the button periodically spreads outward and fades, as if gently breathing, to hint that it's tappable.
MAGIC-pulsating-button.hint: Watch the breathing around the button

MAGIC-ripple-button.name: Ripple Button
MAGIC-ripple-button.summary: A translucent water ripple spreads from where you press, fading as it grows. The feedback lands on your fingertip and never competes with the content.
MAGIC-ripple-button.hint: Press different spots on the button

MAGIC-shimmer-button.name: Shimmer Button
MAGIC-shimmer-button.summary: A thin beam of light runs around the button's edge at a steady pace, and the button sinks slightly when pressed. Suits the main button on a home page.
MAGIC-shimmer-button.hint: Watch the light make one loop of the edge

MAGIC-shine-border.name: Shine Border
MAGIC-shine-border.summary: A multicolor gradient flows slowly around the card border, with the light staying on the edge line and never entering the content area. It's slow enough to feel like breathing.
MAGIC-shine-border.hint: Watch the border colors drift slowly

MAGIC-text-animate.name: Text Animate
MAGIC-text-animate.summary: A whole sentence is split by character, word or line and enters segment by segment in a stagger. Ten entrance styles to choose from, from blurred fade-ins to springy scaling.
MAGIC-text-animate.hint: Switch the entrance style and replay

MAGIC-word-rotate.name: Word Rotate
MAGIC-word-rotate.summary: A set of words takes turns in the same spot: the old word fades out downward and the new one drops in from above, at a steady rhythm. Often used for the changing word in a tagline.

MP-accordion.name: Accordion
MP-accordion.summary: Only one item opens at a time: tap a title and the content grows from 0 to its natural height while fading in, as the previously open item closes at the same moment. Opening and closing share one curve, and the arrow flips along.
MP-accordion.hint: Tap a title to open or close
changes: accordion.tsx: added @ts-nocheck (type drift, verified at runtime)

MP-animated-background.name: Animated Background
MP-animated-background.summary: A group of buttons shares one highlight plate: when you tap (or hover) another button, the plate springs from its old position to the new one, resizing to fit the new button; in hover mode it fades out when the pointer moves away.
MP-animated-background.hint: Tap different options · or switch to hover mode and sweep across them

MP-animated-group.name: Animated Group
MP-animated-group.summary: A group of children enters one after another at 0.1s intervals, in a style set by a preset: fade, slide up, scale, blur, or spring-driven bounce, flip, rotate and swing. A custom variants object can replace any layer.
MP-animated-group.hint: Hit replay to watch the blocks enter in turn, and switch presets to see different entrances
changes: animated-group.tsx: added @ts-nocheck (type drift, verified at runtime)

MP-animated-number.name: Animated Number
MP-animated-number.summary: When the value changes it doesn't jump: a spring carries it from the old value to the new one, with thousands separators. At a bounce of 0 it's a clean ease-out; raise the bounce and it wobbles around the target before settling.
MP-animated-number.hint: Tap the number to add another entry
changes: animated-number.tsx: added @ts-nocheck (type drift, verified at runtime)

MP-border-trail.name: Border Trail
MP-border-trail.summary: A glowing segment runs around the card border at a steady pace, hugging the rounded corners with offset-path while a mask reveals only the border ring. Speed and segment length are adjustable, and it adds a breathing feel to a card that's being processed.
MP-border-trail.hint: Watch the light circle the border

MP-carousel.name: Carousel
MP-carousel.summary: The whole track follows your finger as you drag, and on release a spring snaps it to the adjacent page in the direction you dragged. The arrows on the sides and the dots at the bottom also change pages, with the arrows only showing on hover by default.
MP-carousel.hint: Drag left or right, or tap the arrows or dots

MP-cursor.name: Cursor
MP-cursor.summary: Hides the system cursor and has any element follow the pointer instead, scaling and fading in on entering the area and fading out on leaving. Following can be instant, or given a spring duration so it trails half a beat behind.
MP-cursor.hint: Move the pointer into the gradient area

MP-dialog.name: Dialog
MP-dialog.summary: A modal built on the native dialog: the backdrop dims with a slight blur, the panel scales and fades in from slightly smaller, and shrinks back the other way on close. Esc, a click on the backdrop and the close button all dismiss it, and page scrolling is locked while it's open.
MP-dialog.hint: Tap to open, close with Esc or by clicking the backdrop

MP-disclosure.name: Disclosure
MP-disclosure.summary: One trigger with one block of content: after a tap the content grows from 0 in height while fading in, and a second tap collapses it. It only handles a single item and, unlike an accordion, isn't mutually exclusive, suiting small expansions like "View details" or "More info".
MP-disclosure.hint: Tap the title to open or close
changes: disclosure.tsx: added @ts-nocheck (type drift, verified at runtime)

MP-dock.name: Dock
MP-dock.summary: A macOS-style dock: as the pointer sweeps by, the icon nearest it grows to the maximum and those on either side taper off by distance, lifting the whole dock's height; one set of spring parameters drives both width and height, and a label pops up above the hovered icon.
MP-dock.hint: Sweep the pointer left and right across the icons
changes: dock.tsx: added @ts-nocheck (type drift, verified at runtime)

MP-glow-effect.name: Glow Effect
MP-glow-effect.summary: A blurred gradient sits under the card and keeps changing according to its mode: a conic gradient rotating, a radial gradient breathing or pulsing, hue cycling, or horizontal flow. The card itself stays still; only the ring of light at its edge moves.
MP-glow-effect.hint: Watch the light at the card edge, and switch modes to see different motions
changes: glow-effect.tsx: added @ts-nocheck (type drift, verified at runtime)

MP-image-comparison.name: Image Comparison
MP-image-comparison.summary: Two images are stacked with a divider in the middle: drag it and the clipped areas on both sides change to reveal each image's share. The divider can follow your hand directly, trail the pointer on a spring with some inertia, or follow on hover alone.
MP-image-comparison.hint: Press and drag the divider sideways · or switch to hover mode

MP-in-view.name: In View
MP-in-view.summary: The moment an element scrolls into the viewport it transitions from hidden to shown (just a fade by default, here set to float up and unblur), and on scrolling out it can reset or play only once. It listens with useInView and uses no scroll events.

MP-infinite-slider.name: Infinite Slider
MP-infinite-slider.summary: The content is duplicated end to end and slides at a steady pace with no visible jump at the seam. On hover it doesn't stop dead but eases down by the remaining distance to a different speed, then speeds back up when you move away.

MP-magnetic.name: Magnetic
MP-magnetic.summary: When the pointer nears, the element is pulled toward it, tighter the closer it gets, and swings back to place on a loose spring after you leave. The pull range can count only the element itself, its parent container, or the whole page.
MP-magnetic.hint: Circle the pointer around the button

MP-morphing-dialog.name: Morphing Dialog
MP-morphing-dialog.summary: Tap a card and instead of opening a new window, it grows itself and moves to the center of the screen as a dialog: the cover, title and subtitle transition continuously through shared layout while the body fades in separately, and it shrinks back to its spot on close.
MP-morphing-dialog.hint: Tap the card and watch it grow into a dialog

MP-morphing-popover.name: Morphing Popover
MP-morphing-popover.summary: Tap the button and the button itself grows into a popover through shared layout, with its label sliding into the popover as the title; click outside or press Esc and the popover shrinks back to the button's shape.
MP-morphing-popover.hint: Tap "Write a note", then click outside to close
changes: morphing-popover.tsx: added @ts-nocheck (type drift, verified at runtime)

MP-progressive-blur.name: Progressive Blur
MP-progressive-blur.summary: Several backdrop-filter layers are staggered with gradient masks so the blur ramps smoothly from 0 at one end to full at the other, rather than a hard-edged frosted glass. Often laid over an image or list edge; here it fades in on hover and lifts out a caption.
MP-progressive-blur.hint: Hover to see the progressive blur appear at the bottom

MP-scroll-progress.name: Scroll Progress
MP-scroll-progress.summary: A thin bar stretches from left to right with the scroll position, with a spring in the middle, so fast scrolling doesn't snap it hard but lets it catch up smoothly. It can track the page scroll or a specified scroll container.
MP-scroll-progress.hint: Scroll inside the box and watch the progress bar at the top
changes: scroll-progress.tsx: added @ts-nocheck (type drift, verified at runtime)

MP-sliding-number.name: Sliding Number
MP-sliding-number.summary: Each digit is a vertical reel from 0 to 9. When the value changes, only the digits that changed roll, taking the shortest path (9 to 0 flips forward rather than rewinding 9 steps), settling on a spring with a touch of bounce.
MP-sliding-number.hint: Watch the seconds digit roll once a second
changes: sliding-number.tsx: added @ts-nocheck (type drift, verified at runtime)

MP-spinning-text.name: Spinning Text
MP-spinning-text.summary: A sentence is broken into single characters placed at equal angles around a ring, and the whole ring spins at a steady pace without stopping. Radius, font size, speed and direction are all parameters, often used as a badge or a loading placeholder.
MP-spinning-text.hint: Watch it spin, then change the radius and direction
changes: spinning-text.tsx: added @ts-nocheck (type drift, verified at runtime)

MP-spotlight.name: Spotlight
MP-spotlight.summary: A blurred radial spot follows the pointer inside the card. The card's inner layer is opaque, so light only leaks through the thin gap around the border, like a highlight tracing the outline that follows your hand; it fades in on enter and out on leave.
MP-spotlight.hint: Move the pointer over the card

MP-text-effect.name: Text Effect
MP-text-effect.summary: A sentence is split by word, letter or line and enters piece by piece, in a style set by a preset: fade, unblur, float-up with unblur, scale, or slide up. Rhythm comes from two speed controls: the overall stagger pace and each segment's own duration.
MP-text-effect.hint: Hit replay to enter once more, and change the preset and split

MP-text-loop.name: Text Loop
MP-text-loop.summary: A set of words takes turns in the same spot at a fixed interval: the old word floats up and fades while the new one rises in from below, with overflow clipped by the container. The transition curve and variants can both be swapped, and it's often used on the changing word in a tagline.

MP-text-morph.name: Text Morph
MP-text-morph.summary: When the word changes, it isn't a whole-word fade: letters the two words share stay and slide to their new spots through shared layout, extra letters fade out and missing letters fade in. The spring parameters decide how crisp the slide is.
MP-text-morph.hint: Tap to swap words and watch the shared letters move

MP-text-roll.name: Text Roll
MP-text-roll.summary: Each letter has an upper and lower copy: the upper one flips back around the X axis while the lower one flips up right behind to take its place, staggered slightly from left to right like a row of flip cards. Often used as a nav link's hover effect.

MP-text-scramble.name: Text Scramble
MP-text-scramble.summary: The whole sentence first turns into random characters, then settles into the real text one slot at a time from left to right, shuffling a fresh batch of noise every frame. Total duration and refresh interval are controlled separately, and the character set can be swapped for digits or symbols.

MP-text-shimmer-wave.name: Text Shimmer Wave
MP-text-shimmer-wave.summary: Each character in turn lifts forward, scales up, flips slightly around the Y axis and lights up, then drops back, wave after wave sweeping left to right. With an extra layer of 3D rise and fall over flat shimmer, it suits waiting states like "Generating".

MP-text-shimmer.name: Text Shimmer
MP-text-shimmer.summary: A bright band sweeps right to left across gray text at a steady pace, clipped to the glyphs with the background and looping without a break. Its width scales with the character count and color is set through two CSS variables, and it's often used as a "Generating" loading cue.
MP-text-shimmer.hint: Watch the light band loop across

MP-tilt.name: Tilt
MP-tilt.summary: As the pointer moves over the card, it tilts around the X and Y axes under 1000px perspective: whichever corner the pointer is at lifts (or presses down, if reversed). After you leave, two springs slowly swing it back to flat.
MP-tilt.hint: Move the pointer over the card

MP-toolbar-dynamic.name: Toolbar Dynamic
MP-toolbar-dynamic.summary: A small toolbar with two icons: tap search and the whole bar springs from 98px to 300px wide, its content swapping to a back button plus an input that gets focus automatically; tap back or click outside and it shrinks again. This is the upstream finished example, with no adjustable props.
MP-toolbar-dynamic.hint: Tap the magnifier, then tap back or click outside
changes: toolbar-dynamic.tsx: added @ts-nocheck (type drift, verified at runtime)

MP-toolbar-expandable.name: Toolbar Expandable
MP-toolbar-expandable.summary: A bottom toolbar with four icons: tap any icon and a panel springs out above to show the matching content, with its height measured from the content. Switching icons changes the height continuously, and tapping the same one or clicking outside closes it (an upstream finished example, with no adjustable props).
MP-toolbar-expandable.hint: Tap different icons and watch the panel change content
changes: toolbar-expandable.tsx: added @ts-nocheck (type drift, verified at runtime)

MP-transition-panel.name: Transition Panel
MP-transition-panel.summary: Switch a set of panels by index: the old panel slides out to one side with a blur and fade while the new one slides in sharp from the other. The exiting panel is pulled out of document flow, so both can be present at once without crowding each other.
MP-transition-panel.hint: Tap the tabs above to switch

SET-restrained.name: Subtle · Utility
SET-restrained.for: For SaaS, back offices, productivity tools and content sites: motion only confirms actions and explains state, never stealing attention.
rules: At most one auto-looping effect per screen (shimmer sweep or pulse); everything else is triggered by user action.
Durations of 150–400ms, mostly ease-out; use springs only for button presses and the tab indicator.
No background-style effects or border glow; cards get only a hover spotlight.

Palette: low saturation with a block of beige or ice blue as the base; in dark themes use the dark variant straight from the palette. For tool-style interfaces start with Crow Blue, Faded Yellow, and for a cooler look choose Clear Ice Blue.

picks.why: Shrinks to 0.97 on press, bounces back on release, lifts slightly on hover; the same feel for every button on the site.
A heavy-feeling thumb bounce on the same spring tier as the button press.
An underline indicator glides across, quieter than a pill.
Height transition plus content fade-in with no extra bounce; use it for FAQs and settings groups.
Draggable, with indicator dots and no bounce; for showing content.
Light scale-and-fade, with a 300ms delay so it doesn't flicker when swept over.
Morphs in the center and its height follows when content switches; one modal for the whole flow.
Stacks at the bottom right, up to 3 at a time, and can be swiped away.
Counts to the target only once it enters the viewport, fast at first and then slowing; for dashboards and stat cards.
A 6px offset plus blur fade-in; use this one for every paragraph and card entrance.
A spotlight follows the pointer and looks like a plain card when idle.
The plainest ring spinner, with size and color following the text color so it fits anywhere; switch to a progress ring when progress is known.
A breathing placeholder for before content arrives; pick either this or the loading ring.

SET-springy.name: Bouncy · Consumer
SET-springy.for: For consumer apps, communities and gamified products: every action has weight and bounce, so the whole thing feels good to touch.
rules: Use one spring tier across the whole site (consistent stiffness / damping); don't give each button its own feel.
At most two springs moving at once on a screen; use text entrance only once, on the first screen.
Drag controls (sliders, slide-to-confirm) must be re-grabbable midway; leave velocity handoff to apple-design for review.
Palette: macaron and cream tones. Pastel is the liveliest, Matcha Latte the quietest, and Honey Peach sits between them; in dark themes keep the primary color bright and don't dim it.

picks.why: Gets pulled toward the pointer as it nears, then bounces back on press; keep the strength under 0.5.
Flows idle → loading → success within one button, with its width following along.
Takes effect only when slid all the way, and bounces back if released midway; use it for delete and payment.
A round icon button opens to reveal its text and bounces back when collapsed.
The selected plate hops between icons, dock style.
The opened item springs away from its neighbors by a small gap and settles back when closed.
A draggable carousel with inertia; use it for product and card feeds.
The thumb gives a little bounce when it lands on a tick.
Rolls digit by digit; use it for prices and changing counts.
Words spring up with an unblur; use it only for the first-screen title.
Tilts with the pointer; up to 10° is enough.
The dot grid shies away as the pointer nears, adding one more layer to that touchable feel.
Morphs up from the bottom, which is smoother on phones.
Stacks at top center, and a toast changes from loading to success.
Three bouncing dots, the same temperament as the site's springs.

SET-showy.name: Showy · Brand Landing Page
SET-showy.for: For product home pages, launch pages and campaign pages: one or two big moves are allowed to catch the eye, with the rest kept restrained as a backdrop.
rules: One star per screen: choose either a background (meteors / orbits) or a card glow, never both.
Text effects only on the first-screen title and one subtitle; body paragraphs use the blur fade-in from the Subtle set.
Confetti is thrown once, only when something is truly completed (a payment, a successful sign-up).
Palette: highly saturated contrasting colors on a dark base, with the dark theme for the landing page's first screen; all three sets can carry large gradients or light-effect backgrounds.

picks.why: A beam of light circles the edge; only the main CTA on the page gets it.
Color fills in from one side on hover, forming a primary-secondary pair with the main button's light.
Enters word by word, rising out of a blur.
A glint of light loops across; use it for small labels like "New" and "Beta".
One word in the headline swaps every 2.5 seconds.
Letters thicken one by one as the pointer sweeps by, a hover easter egg for navigation and big headlines.
Elements that fall and can be dragged; place it in only one spot.
A meteor shower behind the first screen; swap in orbiting circles if you want it to feel more like a product.
A beam of light runs along the card border; pick either this or the background.
A spring-driven rolling number, for something like "10,000+ users".
A marquee of reviews or logos that stops on hover.
Throw confetti once on a successful sign-up or payment.
A comet spinner with a trailing tail, worthy of a showy first screen.

REF-designspells.summary: 338 recordings of micro-interactions, easter eggs and holiday surprises in real products (the sheet transition in Sudoku a Day, Pinterest's long-press menu, ChatGPT's option animations…), one short video each. The on-site tags Mobile / Desktop / Interaction / Easter Egg / Skeuomorphic / Fun / Apple / Animation / 404 / Motion / Occasion are in-page filters with no standalone links.
REF-designspells.when: Spend ten minutes here when you're out of ideas, want to see how others delight with a small detail, or want to add an easter egg or a holiday special to a product.
REF-designspells.title: Magic in the details of real products

REF-ripplix.summary: Real app motion recordings sorted by component and gesture, covering phones, web and watches. What you see is what others have already shipped.
REF-ripplix.when: When building mobile interactions and you want to see the pace of a certain gesture (pull down, swipe to delete, bottom sheet) in real apps.
REF-ripplix.title: 7,000+ real app motion recordings

REF-pageflows.summary: Full-flow recordings of sign-up, onboarding, payment and search from products like Airbnb, Uber and Netflix, searchable by flow type.
REF-pageflows.when: When designing a whole flow (onboarding, checkout, invites) rather than a single component.
REF-pageflows.title: Recordings of 100,000 real user flows

REF-mobbin.summary: A library of real screenshots searchable by product, page type and UI element, covering both mobile and web; it's also what the vela design checklist uses when looking up product UI.
REF-mobbin.when: When settling a full-page layout, or checking what mainstream versions of a page type (settings, empty states, paywalls) look like.
REF-mobbin.title: 400,000 real app and web screenshots

REF-refero.summary: Tens of thousands of web and iOS screenshots searchable by page, component and industry; its sister site Refero Styles organizes the styles of 2,000+ products into AI-readable DESIGN.md files.
REF-refero.when: When looking for a mature way of doing a specific component (pricing table, filter, empty state).
REF-refero.title: A UI reference library for web and iOS

REF-refero-styles.summary: One page per product: screenshots, colors, fonts and spacing, plus a DESIGN.md an AI can read directly. It follows the same path as our "settle the style first, then produce pages in bulk" approach.
REF-refero-styles.when: When a new project needs a style foundation and you want to start from a mature product's guidelines, take its DESIGN.md as the starting point.

demo_text.减少动效模式不是关掉一切，而是把位移换成淡入淡出，把连续变化换成直接到位。: Reduced-motion mode doesn't turn everything off; it swaps movement for fades and continuous change for an instant jump.
